product_metadata.title: VHC Brands Kettle Grove Shower Curtain 72x72 Primitive Country Patchwork Design, Country Black and Creme
features: SIZE: The Kettle Grove Shower Curtain is 72 inches wide by 72 inches long.
COUNTRY PATCHWORK DESIGN: Traditional style that compliments any country, rustic, or Americana home. Kettle Grove features country black, khaki tan, and dark creme in a traditional patchwork design.

PREMIUM CONSTRUCTION: Our heirloom-quality pieces are built to last for years to come. Our 100% cotton traditional patchwork shower curtain is expertly machine stitched in India. Features a 1.5 inch header and 1 inch button holes for shower curtain hooks (not included). Plastic liner recommended (not included).

COORDINATES AVAILABLE: Pair this shower curtain with pieces from our entire Kettle Grove collection for a complete look. Available in quilts, bedding accessories, curtains, rugs, bath coordinates and kitchen tabletop items.
EASY CARE: machine wash, tumble dry low, iron safe
